registered_dependency_graph.reason: D065-D070 Java upstream owners remain unregistered. All six physical inputs are governed explicitly by Source schema/WAL/version/hash checks and SOURCE_TABLES, without fake registrations or provider ingestion claims.

formulas_and_nulls.direct_values: Rename only, preserving stored binary64 units, nulls and signed zero; no scaling, rounding or positivity/range assumptions.
formulas_and_nulls.gdp: Use report_date own month only. Java also checks quarter string agrees with exact quarter-end date. No forward fill/carry into subsequent months.
formulas_and_nulls.new_rmb_loan: Compatibility column name for sf_month.inc_month, total social financing increment; not a distinct RMB-loan series.
formulas_and_nulls.social_financing_yoy: current stk_endval / preceding twelfth sorted physical observation stk_endval - 1. Original pct_change(12,fill_method=None) occurs before monthly dedup. Fractional ratio, no multiplication by100; missing/null baseline produces null, zero denominator/nonfinite result is rejected.
formulas_and_nulls.duplicates: Python sorts then groupby(month).tail(1), with no tie breaker for duplicate normalized periods. Java bounded contract rejects duplicate or unordered physical periods instead of arbitrarily reproducing a tie.
formulas_and_nulls.merge: Outer merge on month; add absent output columns as null; order all nine outputs by model schema; withhold candidates missing any required six monthly values.
formulas_and_nulls.read_compatibility: All eight metrics remain nullable finite Double for historical typed READ. New typed WRITE and Source publication enforce the required six.
formulas_and_nulls.incremental: Entire closed-month bootstrap prefix must contain each expected month with six required values. Missing/withheld months fail before publication; they do not become empty success or advance checkpoint.

unit_references.scope: Historical local upstream specifications explain declared units, not a current provider-wide certification. Mapper preserves actual stored values unchanged.

unit_references.social_financing_yoy: Dimensionless fractional ratio derived from same-unit stocks.

bounded_java_source.scan_limit_caveat: Returned-row caps and deadlines do not certify internal database scan volume.

checkpoint_and_unknown.checkpoint: Only closed contiguous VERIFIED full prefix with exact saved source/raw context and target9-field values. Unchanged old raw prefix permits one-month overlap; source revision returns to finite bootstrap; target drift rejects.
checkpoint_and_unknown.empty: Empty source may emit one empty FETCHED source page/slice, completed as VERIFIED_EMPTY; zero SUBMITTED publication/HTTP and no checkpoint advancement.
checkpoint_and_unknown.publication: Shared runner SQLite SUBMITTED intent before one synchronous HTTP flush; autoFlush disabled, retry timeout0, reset/close discards buffered rows.
checkpoint_and_unknown.unknown: IN_DOUBT/allDates exclusion retained, no automatic retry/resend. Reconcile requires original same-service-instance stopped sender plus frozen source/full-prefix exact target/WAL proof; a fresh JVM cannot manufacture this proof.
